validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/SPEC all independently confirmed against TWO sources, neither GEM. (1) The row's own cited EGAS Annual Report 2018 PDF (egyptoil-gas.com .../EGAS-Annual-Report-2018-EN.pdf) carries the GASCO 'National Gas Grid' map on the printed page footer-numbered '35' (PDF page 19). This is an IMAGE, not extractable text, so url_verifier and any full-text search correctly find nothing on this page -- I visually read the map at 400dpi instead of trusting the text screen (per this scope's map-reading rule) and it is unambiguous: a green ('Existing P/L') line runs south from the 'Taba' node down the Gulf of Aqaba/Sinai coast through Nuweiba and Dahab to a facility icon labeled 'Sharm El Shekh', with an on-map label reading '20" - 208 k.m' directly on that segment. That is an exact match to GEM's Diameter=20in and a near-exact match to GEM's LengthKnown=206.00km (208 vs 206, ~1%, not material -- plausibly rounding or a slightly different endpoint definition). It is visually and topologically distinct from the Taba-area 'East Gas Pipeline' (36in-264km, feeding Aqaba/Jordan) and from the Trans-Sinai/Abr Sinai family (P8013/P8041/P8044), which cross west-to-east into north Sinai from the Suez side -- Taba-Sharm El Sheikh instead runs north-south along the Gulf of Aqaba coast to the south-Sinai resort area, so this is NOT a duplicate of any roster row. (2) A second, independent, dated primary source: Egypt Oil & Gas Newspaper, May 2007 issue (egyptoil-gas.com .../EOG-Newspaper-May-2007-Issue.pdf), a Ministry of Petroleum year-in-review interview, states verbatim (pdftotext, line ~1666): 'The implementation of Taba/Sharm El Sheikh gas pipeline was completed' among the 2006/2007 project completions -- directly corroborating GEM's StartYear1=2007 and, by a project being described as newly completed and still shown as 'Existing P/L' on the 2018 grid map, corroborating Status=operating (status is inferred from context per the standing rule, not a literal keyword match). Note: url_verifier FAILs the content check on this second URL for the token 'Taba' even though the text is verifiably present -- this is the documented large-PDF extractor limitation (5.9MB, ~6900 lines of extracted text; the verifier's own docstring calls this out) and not a reason to distrust the source; I downloaded and pdftotext'd the file myself to confirm. PipelineType=transmission is correct: this is a long-haul trunk line linking towns/resort centers along a specific route with a stated diameter and length, not a gathering or process line. Location fields (Taba -> Sharm El Sheikh, South Sinai, South Sinai) match the map exactly. No existence, duplicate, or classification concern found.
